metadata.description: Learning Producers' own marketplace: the Combat Writing plugin and its local add-on.

plugins.name: combat-writing
plugins.description: Combat Writing: a crew of AI model seats attacks your draft, rates it 1 to 10 with 7 forbidden, then reads each other and rates again. The rating leads every result.

plugins.name: combat-writing-crew
plugins.description: The Combat Writing add-on: a local MCP server that sends each seat's packet to other companies' models on your own API keys. Not listed in the Claude plugin directory. Arrives in part 5 of the build.
